links.comparator_used: Same GPT-5.2 model without retrieval-augmented generation (No-RAG), given identical angiographic frames and structured clinical text
links.outcome: Agreement between LLM-predicted and invasively measured iFR (MAE, RMSE, correlation) and threshold-based classification accuracy
links.quote: With RAG, point estimates favored improved continuous agreement, with MAE decreasing to 0.029, RMSE to 0.038, and correlation increasing to r = 0.830 (p < 0.001).
